calculate_rmsd_between_atoms: calculate the RMSD between ORCA and MLIP optimized atom structures after minimizing rotation and translation
compute_interaction_energy_and_forces: compute the interaction energy and forces for a supersystem like a ligand pocket from component results
evaluate_ligand_pocket_metrics: evaluate ligand pocket error metrics including energy MAE and interaction forces MAE between ORCA and MLIP results
evaluate_ligand_strain_metrics: evaluate ligand strain error metrics including strain energy MAE and global minimum RMSD between ORCA and MLIP results
evaluate_singlepoint_metrics: evaluate singlepoint energy MAE, energy per atom MAE, and forces MAE between ORCA and MLIP results
